Hey OTers!

As you've probably seen, we've been busy getting more closed beta testers into the game and we're slowly getting there. While you may be queued for a while, there are players jumping on every few minutes to queue up, so give it some time and you'll find a match. We're partnering with some web sites right now to help us get more players in ASAP. On top of that, we've decided to go Early Access with One Tower instead of a full release, which will enable us to open the doors earlier to players, but also gives us more time to polish it, add the content and features we want to add, and fix any big bugs/balance issues.

FIXES & ADDITIONS

  • Challenging friends now works (limited - some intermittent issues we need to test further)
  • Fixed some game crashing errors on load.
  • Fixed an issue where players couldn't get past authentication screen.
  • Fixed an issue where sometimes players would receive Error: True message.
  • Added in video settings
  • Audio settings now save
  • Fixed null friend issue
  • Fixed minion naming
  • Recent matches show on profile now
  • Fixed steam MTX failures
  • Fixed long text issues
  • Improvements to minion audio
  • Improvements to UI audio
  • Balance improvements, including better anti-air
  • New heroic minions added
  • Continued balance improvements to heroes
  • Edge scroll added
  • Status effect icons added (i.e. stunned, burning, etc.)
  • When out of crystals it now prompts you with crystals screen.
  • Added a save button to minion manager
  • Cleaned up Wildfire, Bjorn and Lyla animations
  • Added health pickup behind towers
  • Removed placeholder badges from profile
  • Increased tower damage and range
  • Increased damage against heroes to prevent diving.
  • Added symbols to powerups to make their effects clearer
  • Networking improvements
  • Added voiceovers to heroes
  • Added tower destroy phase vs. immediately taking you to victory screen

KNOWN ISSUES & BUGS

  • Tutorial missing (temporarily disabled, being renabled)
  • When server is unreachable players will get stuck on the "Authenticating" screen.
  • Sometimes players are disconnected from game server without being reconnected or told.
  • With certain video resolutions there are graphical glitches that may appear within the UI.
  • When clicking on a minion in collection screen it flashes "evolve."
  • Hero effect icons are blurry
  • Difficult to attack air with Reaper and Wildfire's ranged.
  • When purchasing minions from chests, if you go directly to minion manager it won't show new minions.
  • Invisible minion bug - sometimes minions will go undead.
  • At the end of matches the incorrect screen will flash before seeing defeat/victory screen.
  • After destroying a tower the game continues for a short period.
  • When deploying a Legend minion (dragon or troll) the game lags briefly.
  • Wrong audio voiceover plays when an enemy gets killed by trap
  • Mini-map is at the wrong angle (old camera angle)
  • Backing out of a matchmaking queue sometimes pulls you back into a match if you weren't disconnected successfully from queue
  • Volume balance issues
  • Jungle enemies sometimes stay aggressive
  • Some crashing occuring on older machine specs. Requires further testing
  • Can't see your name in chat lobby

UPCOMING FEATURES

  • Surrender indication on match end screen if opponent surrendered
  • Show Player level in Scorecard
  • Improved anti-air attacking
  • Minion details in collection area
  • Chest purchases with crystals will grant players XP to ensure fair play and prevent P2W.
  • Minion manager sorting
  • Preview player name in color changer
  • Account Levels will be represented by titles with emblems
  • Map improvements/polish
  • UI improvements/polish
  • Improved match results screen
  • Improved match starting screen
  • Additional hotkeys for minion panel
  • Ability to rematch a player
  • News inside the UI instead of opening a browser
  • Ranked matches
  • Viewing other player profiles
  • + More!

What we need the most help with from our players is to have the following:

  1. Information on any crashes or major bugs experienced during the game.
  2. Any 'confusion' or pain points that cause frustrations.
  3. Feedback on the game - is it fun? What would make it more fun? What's missing?

You can follow us at http://www.twitch.tv/onetower to get reminded for when we go online.
